correctness.rationale: Proof on arbitrary connected block graphs: simplicial vertices never appear internally on a geodesic, so any subset works. A selected cut vertex c forces at most one selected and at most one unselected component of G-c, hence c has exactly two pure branches and selected set equals one branch plus c. General position forces selected branch to be a full pendant clique with c its only cut vertex and c occurring in two blocks. Conversely this clique has geodesically convex complement. This proves D_G=(1+z)^s+sum_B z^|B| and hereditary iff correction absent; blocks of size k<=s. Independent exhaustive P4 vertex-subset test yields [1,2,3,0,0], including the single qualified leaf-degree2 edge correction; universal claim proven structurally, not from small enumeration.
